pattern.title: Re-check a shortlisted agent skill choice
pattern.value: Give a code-chosen shortlist a detailed choose-or-none re-check before an agent loads a skill.
pattern.success_metric: Distinguish one-skill fit, no fit within the offered shortlist, incomplete evidence, and tasks requiring multiple listed skills.

skill.instructions: Apply these four mutually exclusive tiers in this exact order. (1) Select insufficient if user_task or skill_shortlist is missing, empty, unreadable or unclear; if capability needs cannot be determined; or if a task-required capability is not described by any offered entry. (2) Select multiple_required only if no single offered entry can complete the task and two or more distinct listed entries are each necessary and together cover it. (3) Otherwise, if one or more single offered entries can each complete the whole task, select the most direct/best fit; if equally fitting, select the earliest listed. (4) Select no_skill only if the task and descriptions are clear, none of the offered entries materially fits, and no specific required capability is missing from this shortlist. no_skill means no fit in this shortlist, not none in the full catalog. Judge full descriptions, not names. A suggestion never loads a skill or authorizes action.

criteria.document_editor: One offered document-editing skill, used alone, directly and sufficiently performs the clear requested task.
criteria.data_analysis: One offered structured-data analysis skill, used alone, directly and sufficiently performs the clear requested task.
criteria.browser_test: One offered browser-testing skill, used alone, directly and sufficiently performs the clear requested task.
criteria.multiple_required: No single offered skill can complete the clear task, but at least two distinct listed skills are each required and together cover it.
criteria.no_skill: The task and listed descriptions are clear, none of the offered skills materially fits, and no specific required capability is known to be omitted.
criteria.insufficient: Required task/list evidence is missing, empty, unreadable, or ambiguous; the task's scope or needed capability set cannot be determined; or a clear required capability is absent from the offered shortlist.

pattern.follow_up: Code may expand the candidate search for insufficient or multiple_required results. For one selected entry, inspect that skill before loading it; no_skill means only that this shortlist has no fit.
pattern.code_owns: Initial broad roster ranking, candidate inclusion, skill loading, permissions, and task execution.
pattern.baseline: Load every superficially matching skill into the prompt.
pattern.comparison_to_prior: Unlike L04's one-pass available handler selection, this is the second, detailed choose-or-none stage after code has formed a broad roster shortlist.
pattern.limits: The result is shortlist-bounded: no_skill does not establish that the full catalog lacks a fit. Code owns candidate coverage, exact membership, skill loading, permissions and execution.

policy.threshold_status: Provisional synthetic screening only; model output is advisory.
